release_notes:
Stable build for Waze **5.28.4.900** (versionCode 1030753). 37 rows.

### The fixes behind the "it applies but nothing happens" reports
Waze's map, alert engine and Android Auto layer read their settings from a **native** config store, not from the Java getters the rows were changing. On this build, 71 of the 80 forced keys never reached it, so the row flipped a settings screen and left the driving behaviour untouched. Every forced key is now written to both stores, strings included, and a check in the build fails if one is missing.

### Rows that were verified dead and rewired
- **YouTube Music / Any audio app** — the partner entries were appended after the list had been measured, so they never entered it. The length is reloaded before the roster is sized.
- **Hide recent destinations** — the empty list was written into the wrong register; callers received `null`, not an empty list.
- **Picture-in-picture** — touches were routed to a hard-coded view id that is a different view on this build; the map is now resolved by name.
- **Lane guidance** — the consumer requires a third flag (`LANE_GUIDANCE_USER_ENABLED`) that was never set.
- **Live drive sharing** — the map button also needs `SHARE_DRIVE_BUTTON_BACK_ENTRY_POINT_ENABLED`.
- **Remove ads** — search results carry their own two gates, now forced.
- **Cameras & hazards** — crosswalks were only switched on in Settings; the two announcement keys are now set, so a mapped crosswalk warns instead of only drawing.
- **Car map zoom** — the write hung off an unrelated setter and could be skipped; it goes through the shared guarded helper on every config sync.
- **Allow high refresh rate** — 90 Hz became 88 and 165 became 160 because the constant truncates the double; such rates are now refused instead of silently changed.
- **Instrument cluster** — the "large layout" option was actually Waze's light-commercial-vehicle mode and was on by default. Off by default, renamed.
- **Smoother Android Auto map** — dropped a key Waze removed in this version.

### Option values are validated
Passing a label where a value token belongs ("Phone only" instead of "phone") used to apply cleanly and change nothing. It now aborts with the accepted values listed.

### Supported builds
Every row is pinned to **5.28.4.900**. Waze 5.27.90.900 uses **0.30.64**, which pins that build; a bundle refuses a build it was not verified against rather than half-applying.

Verified on 5.28.4.900: every row alone (37/37), every option variant (18/18), option effects read back from the built APK (16/16), and all rows together with non-default options — 37/37 applied, 0 broken branch targets, frame count identical to stock, 85/85 forced keys reaching the native store.
